Move without the ache.

Physiotherapy for sore backs, sports injuries and recovery after surgery. We find the cause, treat it with our hands, and give you exercises that actually fit your day.

Book an assessmentShow me where it hurts
48 hrsusual wait for a first visit
5physios, all registered
No GPreferral needed

Where does it hurt?

Tap a spot on the body, or pick from the list. You'll see the problems we treat most there and how many sessions people usually need.

    usual sessions
    typical recovery
    home exercises
    Book for this area

    How it works

    Most people feel a real difference within three visits.

    Assessment

    45 minutes. We ask questions, watch how you move and test strength and joints.

    A clear plan

    You'll know what's wrong, how long it should take and what it will cost.

    Treatment

    Hands-on work, dry needling if it helps, and exercises we practise together.

    Back to normal

    We space visits out as you improve and send you off with a plan to stay well.

    Prices

    Most private health plans cover part of each visit. We claim for you on the spot.

    VisitLengthPrice
    First assessment and treatment45 min$110
    Follow-up treatment30 min$90
    Long follow-up45 min$115
    Sports massage60 min$100
    Small group rehab class50 min$35

    Book an assessment

    Tell us where it hurts and when suits you. We'll call back within 2 working hours to confirm.

    What should I wear?

    Something loose, like shorts and a T-shirt, so we can see and move the sore area.

    Do I need a GP referral?

    No. You can book straight in. If you have a referral or scan results, bring them along.

    Can I claim on my insurance?

    Yes. We have instant claiming for all major health funds and handle work injury and car accident claims.

# Physiotherapy

Creator: mmrahmanbappi
Source: https://github.com/mmrahmanbappi/100-free-html-templates/blob/bab6ec6c8900450aab90989d217942a67ad9b16d/health-fitness/physiotherapy/index.html

Extract the ZIP and open index.html. No build, npm dependencies or remote CDN is required.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.

Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

Original single-file HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript retained separately with creator MIT notice.

Stock photography, external fonts, favicons, metadata and remote services are excluded from the runnable edition; original HTML references are preserved as text only.

Original MigBits geometric demo artwork and motion controls are separate adaptations. Forms and checkout are frontend demonstrations, not backend services.

No React conversion is claimed. System font fallback changes the upstream typography. Render validation is not a complete accessibility audit.

Mobile grid minimum widths and word wrapping are corrected for community-center and nonprofit-charity. Dynamic photo references and initially empty image viewers use original artwork.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.
